Rate of Return Information >> How is the rate of return calculated?  

Your personal rate of return is an estimate using the Modified Dietz Method to approximate the performance of your investments for the time period you have selected. The calculation assumes a constant rate of return during the period, weights each investment’s cash flow by the amount of time held, as well as the relative balances held in each investment. The calculation does not reflect sales charges and other fees that funds and/or investment companies may charge.

Notes:
  • Amounts in a self-directed brokerage account are not included in this calculation.
  • Returns displayed as 0.00% represent periods of time for which Insperity does not have rate of return data for your portfolio.
  • As is the case with all market-based investments, past performance does not guarantee future results. The actual rate of return can vary widely over time for long-term investments.
